description: Issues 4 + 5: (4) The vanilla search input in WizardStep2 stores text but has no entity list and shows no results. (5) Next button is not blocked when baseType==='vanilla' and no entity is selected. Fix: create a vanilla-entities data file with ~20 common mobs (including 牛/cow and ニワトリ/chicken for E2E tests), show a filtered entity list in WizardStep2, add selectedVanillaId to WizardFormData, and validate it in WizardPage before allowing Next on step 2.

Export function matchesSearch(entity: VanillaEntity, query: string): boolean that checks query (case-insensitive) against nameJa, nameJaKids, nameEn, and id. Export const VANILLA_MOBS: VanillaEntity[] with at minimum these entries (include ~20 total): { id: 'minecraft:cow', nameJa: '牛', nameJaKids: 'ウシ', nameEn: 'Cow', icon: '🐄', defaultHealth: 10 }, { id: Edit app/src/pages/WizardPage.tsx: (a) Add selectedVanillaId: string | null to WizardFormData interface. (b) Add selectedVanillaId: null to the initial formData state. (c) Add const [vanillaEntityError, setVanillaEntityError] = useState<string | null>(null). (d) In validateStep2: add check — if (formData.baseType === 'vanilla' && !formData.selectedVanillaId) { setVanillaEntityError(t('error.validation.vanillaEntityRequired')); valid = false; }. (e) In handleFormChange: add 'if (patch.selectedVanillaId !== undefined) setVanillaEntityError(null)' and 'if (patch.baseType !== undefined) { setVanillaEntityError(null) }'. (f) Pass vanillaEntityError to WizardStep2: <WizardStep2 ... vanillaEntityError={vanillaEntityError} />. (g) Update WizardStep3 props to pass selectedVanillaId: formData.selectedVanillaId.

Edit app/src/components/wizard/WizardStep2.tsx: (a) Import VANILLA_MOBS and matchesSearch from '@/data/vanilla-entities'. Import useMemo from 'react'. (b) Extend WizardStep2Props.data Pick to include 'selectedVanillaId'. (c) Add vanillaEntityError: string | null to WizardStep2Props. (d) In handleBaseTypeChange: also reset selectedVanillaId: null in the onChange patch. (e) Inside the vanilla expanded section (the div with 'mt-3 p-3.5 bg-gray-50'), after the search <input>, add: compute filteredEntities via useMemo (always show all when query is empty, filter when non-empty). Render a scrollable list (max-h-48 overflow-y-auto) of entity buttons. Each button: role='option', data-testid={'vanilla-entity-' + entity.id}, aria-selected={data.selectedVanillaId === entity.id}, className with selected highlight (bg-[#F0F8EA] border-[#5D9C3B] when selected, else bg-white hover). Content: entity.icon + entity.nameJa + (nameEn) in small text. On click: onChange({ selectedVanillaId: entity.id }). Show 'No results' text when filteredEntities is empty and query is non-empty. (f) After the search+list block, if vanillaEntityError, show a red error message paragraph.

Edit app/src/components/wizard/WizardStep3.tsx: (a) Import VANILLA_MOBS from '@/data/vanilla-entities'. (b) Update WizardStep3Props.data type to include selectedVanillaId: string | null. (c) Update baseLabel computation: if baseType==='vanilla', look up the entity by selectedVanillaId in VANILLA_MOBS to get its nameJa (fallback to vanillaSearch if not found): const vanillaEntity = data.selectedVanillaId ? VANILLA_MOBS.find(e => e.id === data.selectedVanillaId) : null; const baseLabel = data.baseType === 'vanilla' ? (vanillaEntity ? `${t('wizard.step2.fromVanilla')}（${vanillaEntity.nameJa}）` : t('wizard.step2.fromVanilla')) : t('wizard.step2.fromScratch').
Edit app/src/i18n/locales/ja.json: in the error.validation object add: 'vanillaEntityRequired': 'バニラエンティティを選択してください'.
Edit app/src/i18n/locales/ja-kids.json: in the error.validation object add: 'vanillaEntityRequired': 'Vanilla（バニラ）をえらんでください'.
Edit app/src/i18n/locales/en.json: in the error.validation object add: 'vanillaEntityRequired': 'Please select a vanilla entity'.

When user types 'ニワトリ', the chicken entity (🐔 鶏) appears in results
Clicking an entity row highlights it and stores its id in formData.selectedVanillaId
Clicking Next on step 2 with vanilla mode and no entity selected shows error 'バニラエンティティを選択してください'
With vanilla mode and an entity selected, Next proceeds to step 3
WizardStep3 summary shows the selected entity's Japanese name
npm run build passes with 0 TS errors

cd app && npm run build          # 0 TS errors
cd app && npm run lint           # 0 warnings
